sources.entry: Twenty - A modern CRM offering the flexibility of open source, advanced features, and a sleek design. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker
Twenty | Modern CRM, a Salesforce alternative

summary.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM that technical teams can extend as code, with objects, views, workflows and agents, available as a cloud service or self-hosted via Docker Compose.
summary.what_it_does: The README presents Twenty as a customizable CRM for building custom customer-relationship tools that adapt as business needs change. It offers a cloud-hosted workspace at twenty.com, or self-hosting on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose. A Twenty CLI scaffolds an app project where objects, fields and views are defined in TypeScript, then published to a workspace with a login and publish command. The README mentions core primitives (objects, views, workflows, agents), layouts, AI features and CRM features, with links to documentation rather than detail. Building with coding agents is supported through an official skills package for several agent harnesses. The codebase is built on TypeScript, Nx, NestJS, React and PostgreSQL.
use_cases: self-hosted CRM for a small team
customer relationship management with custom objects
building a custom CRM app as code
replacing a Salesforce-style CRM with open source
notable: Define CRM objects, fields and views as TypeScript code via the Twenty CLI and SDK
Official skills for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
Available as hosted cloud or self-hosted with Docker Compose
Built-in workflows and agents alongside CRM objects and views
caveats: Self-hosting details (requirements, configuration) are only referenced via links, not described in the README
The agent-skills branch only exists after the first successful publish from main
